scope.description: Which coins of the ranked set the column ranks among: 'all' ranks every coin in the set, and a category scope ranks only the coins it holds — its asset class (crypto, tradfi) or its coins' main category — with the rank and its universe counted over those coins. A scope holding fewer than 5 coins in the set ranks none. Accepted only where the column ranks the tracked universe.
